ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black) surface with a high-intensity (white) pixel ratio estimated at less than 0.05, localized primarily at the fluke tips and scattered punctate markings.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: A single contiguous low-intensity black field covering approximately 95% of the visible surface. High-contrast white clusters are mapped to the distal left and right tips. Sparse white circular pixels are distributed across the mid-ventral region of both lobes.

localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Several distinct, unaligned white linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) are visible; two prominent diagonal parallel marks on the left-central lobe and smaller, less defined marks on the mid-right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Multiple white linear abrasions (scars) across the ventral surface and significant biological encrustation at the distal fluke tips.
